race.comment: DISCREET POINT (1) has the right profile to take beating after finishing fourth in a BM68 at Eagle Farm, beaten just over a length, following a second at this track in a BM66. The return to 1005m suits his established distance record, and the easier company from that mid-week assignment gives him a clear chance to convert. KIRRA'S SISTER (3) is the obvious danger on consistency, having gone down by a neck at this venue after another close placing in a CL3 at Grafton, with the 3kg claim adding to her appeal. IMMORTAL STORM (2) resumes after ending last campaign with two thirds, including a neck defeat at this track, and his overall record keeps him right in calculations if he is forward enough. ZOSMA (4) brings winning form after scoring narrowly at Port Macquarie and has a solid career profile, though he still has to prove that result away from soft-ground CL1 grade. Can repeat the dose. DAZZLING PEACE (5) can feature with a couple of nice trials under his belt.
